verses.verse:
तेन बंशी तृधा लोके दृश्यते तृगुणात्मिका।
तासाम् नामानि त्रिपुराथ कृष्णा च जिह्वावती।।९।।
verses.text: Hence the flute is seen in the world in three kinds, resting on the three guṇas; their names are Tripurā, Kṛṣṇā and Jihvāvatī.

commentary.text: Thus three kinds of flute, the gift of three ages and based on the three guṇas, are mainly in use today. Their names are Tripurā (the flute blown from the bamboo's natural opening), Kṛṣṇā (the transverse, side-blown flute) and Jihvāvatī (the fipple flute). Then, on the basis of these, many suṣira vādya (wind instruments), such as the bīn (reed pipe) and the shehnai, are held to have arisen.
